technical.summary: Hull MA flip and volume spike provide short-term bullish structure, but price remains below major moving averages and cloud with negative money flow, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: SHW shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 93 days.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (306.7) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 93 days poses no immediate binary risk but compounds unfavourable backdrop.
